sloka: विंशतिर्दश चाष्टौ च तूण्यो ऽस्य रथमास्थिताः।कार्मुकानि च भीमानि ज्याश्च काञ्चनपिङ्गलाः ।। ६.७१.२० ।।
transliteration: viṁśatirdaśa cāṣṭau ca tūṇyo 'sya rathamāsthitāḥ।kārmukāni ca bhīmāni jyāśca kāñcanapiṅgalāḥ ।। 6.71.20 ।।

translations.english: "This chariot has twenty quivers, ten frightening bows, and eight bow strings of golden colour lay arranged in the chariot."
